verdict_reason: Correctly wired for testcontainers 2.0.2 (opt-in withReplicaSet + getReplicaSetUrl) and sets no default identity header, but provides no per-test database cleanup hook, leaving IT isolation to per-subclass discipline.

todos.issue: The new IntegrationBase starts one shared MongoDB container and one shared Spring context for every IT but provides no per-test cleanup hook, so collection isolation is opt-in per subclass; 8 ITs each hand-roll repository.deleteAll(), OperatorIndexIT cleans inside its @Test and leaves a saved Address row behind, and MongoConfigIT does no cleanup at all — order dependence is latent rather than prevented.
todos.fix: Add the documented base-class hook: @BeforeEach void cleanDatabase(@Autowired MongoTemplate mongoTemplate) { mongoTemplate.getDb().listCollectionNames().forEach(mongoTemplate::dropCollection); } and drop the duplicated deleteAll() calls from the subclasses.

todos.issue: The base exposes only mockMvc and port, so every derived IT redeclares the same identity constants — ORG_HEADER = "Trade-Imports-Organisation-Id" is copied into 8 new IT classes and the sample organisation UUID into most of them; a header rename means editing 8 files.
todos.fix: Hoist protected static final String ORG_HEADER (and the shared sample organisation id) into IntegrationBase and have the ITs reference them — as constants only, never as a header applied by default.
